resources.string: Affected tracks: %1$d · access aliases: %2$d · CUE segments: %3$d
The file and user relationships stay. The track remains ignored by scanning until you explicitly restore it to the visible library.
Remove app access to this source. External files, favorites and playlist relationships stay.
Related tracks: %1$d · Access aliases: %2$d. Favorites and playlists keep their identities; playback may need another location.
Delete the exact original files listed here. This affects their related tracks, access aliases and CUE segments. Deletion cannot be undone here. Other copies and user relationships stay.
Delete only the listed complete app audio copies. External originals and playlist relationships stay. Removing an app copy is separate from removing a library reference.
Write the reviewed fields to the actual audio file. A complete candidate is checked before replacement. File failure keeps or restores the original when its recorded identity is proven.
Other apps and file names may be affected. Attached lyric files are not moved. Cross-provider moves copy and verify first; deleting the original requires another confirmation.
Pause and close this app’s playback resources for this operation
I reviewed all related tracks, aliases and CUE segments
Tag write paths: native FLAC and untagged MP3 or plain ID3v2.4. Title, artists, album, album artist, track and disc can be edited. Blank fields remove those values; list artists on separate lines.
Move to the selected authorized root and preserve each file name. Add another folder through Sources first if needed. Existing names are never overwritten.
Completed: %1$d · failed: %2$d · not executed: %3$d · recovery required: %4$d
Review retry of the same frozen operation
Restore ignored tracks to visible library
Restore only the exact retained original recorded for this tag replacement. Playback will pause and close. A verified published replacement is never rolled back by this action.
Remove only this operation’s recorded staging file after its original is proven intact or restored. Completed copied audio is kept. Playback will pause and close.
Confirm recovery action and close playback
Review and accept the exact operation and its playback or whole-file impact before continuing.
This provider or grant cannot safely perform the requested file operation. Grant access again or choose another supported source.
This file’s tag/container structure cannot be safely written by this path.
The destination name conflicts with another file. Choose another name or folder.
The complete file/alias scope could not be proven. Review the selected locations again.
Independent byte or tag verification failed. Inspect the recorded original and staging results.
Playback resources were not confirmed closed, so file work stopped. Restart the app and inspect the operation before retrying.
A recorded file change or playback closure needs inspection. Saved local playback remains paused until coordination is complete.
Verified copy retained; original deletion is separate
File changed; coordinating library and queue references
